openXrIssues.message: [Optional] Switch to use InputSystem.XR.PoseControl instead of OpenXR.Input.PoseControl, which will be deprecated in a future release.

[Optional] Switch to use StickControl thumbsticks instead of Vector2Control, but may break existing projects that have code dependencies to the Vector2Control type. StickControl allows more input options for thumbstick-based control, such as acting as both a combined 2D vector, two independent axes or a four-way Dpad with 4 independent buttons.

buildValidationIssues.message: [Compatibility] Disable hand pinch detection through OVRInput, which will be deprecated in a future release. If your project utilizes this behavior, please update your project to use the recommended API for detecting hand pinches going forward: OVRHand.GetFingerIsPinching.
[Features] For MR apps it's recommended to disable Show Splash Screen (in Player Settings). Otherwise it will result in an inconsistent experience
[Features] Newest Meta XR Simulator not installed, consider installing it
[OpenXR] [Optional] Switch to use InputSystem.XR.PoseControl instead of OpenXR.Input.PoseControl, which will be deprecated in a future release.

[OpenXR] [Optional] Switch to use StickControl thumbsticks instead of Vector2Control, but may break existing projects that have code dependencies to the Vector2Control type. StickControl allows more input options for thumbstick-based control, such as acting as both a combined 2D vector, two independent axes or a four-way Dpad with 4 independent buttons.
[Quality] Enable Anisotropic Filtering on a per-texture basis
[Quality] Set maximum pixel lights count to 1
[Rendering] Enable Legacy Graphics Jobs. This can help performance if your application is main thread bound.
[Rendering] Subsampled Layout should be enabled to improve GPU performance when foveation is enabled.
[Rendering] Use recommended MSAA level for Android
[Rendering] Using HDR may significantly impact performance. It is recommended to disable HDR.
